question: 真实tet连接关系到实际接口成员的mesh-edge距离，是否提供区别于同源组最近欧氏距离的输入信息？
selection: 此前已固定和观察的TRAIN CAD；不按新误差选case。仅输入可行性，不创建训练或45CAD任务。

data_access.SolverDeck: GRID coordinates, actual RBE/SPC membership and input metadata only

graph.construction: Each of six original edges contributes cornerA-mid and mid-cornerB; canonical unique undirected pairs before CSR
graph.weight: physical chord length in mm divided by existing isotropic characteristic_length_mm
graph.missing_distance_policy: blocked; never clip, cap, infill, or change sources

sources.channel_order: four actual support member groups sorted by master_node_id, then the actual loaded member group
sources.mapping: Reuse parse_deck and prepare_deepjeb coordinate-to-H5 mapping policy (2e-4mm); additionally reject multiple H5 candidates within tolerance. Master coordinates never replace member sets.
sources.type_note: Original parser identifies support RBE2 and the one loaded RBE3 interface; record actual card type without inventing a loaded RBE2.

readout.all_original_nodes: isolated/component counts and exact reachability masks; per-source unreachable counts
readout.five_channels: node count, source IDs/count/hash, finite/min/max/std, edge/node/geometry identities
readout.comparison: nearestEuclid to the same actual member set divided by L; non-source detour=graphDistance/nearestEuclid, plus correlation and excess-distance RMS
readout.input_parity: Once: exact normalized XYZ/bbox/L and original seven support/load membership slots; loaded-member Euclidean slot23 parity

limits: Mesh-edge path length is mesh dependent, uses straight subedge chords, and is neither exact continuous geodesic nor stiffness/elasticity. Non-redundant distances alone do not establish predictive benefit or generalization. Parent must separately authorize any extension to45CAD or matched training.
